topic.title: One Week Left to Submit to WEAR@HASCA!

messages.content:
Dear participants,

just a quick reminder that technical report submission deadline is approaching (July 4th AoE). Your report needs to be between 3 to 6 pages and must be submitted via PCS (Precision Conference).

Please make sure that you select the your final submission of choice here on Kaggle before the deadline. We will only consider the submission selected on July 4th AoE as your final submission - any late changes are not allowed.

Also note that in order to publish your report within the proceedings of the conference at least one author must pay the registration fee for the main conference and the HASCA workshop! More details on how to register will be made available as soon as the conference has opened their registration system.

Looking forward to your submissions, Marius
